## Why BarkBox?

BarkBox is a monthly surprise that brings joy and enrichment to your pup’s life.

##### Obsession Guaranteed

Packed with wag-worthy toys and tasty treats, designed and hand-picked by experts.

##### Crazy Convenience

Delivering the perfect playtime directly to your door every month.

##### Personalized Play

Customized - from allergy-friendly snacks to toys designed for their size and play style.

## Frequently asked questions

What comes in a BarkBox?

Each monthly BarkBox includes two toys, two bags of treats, and a chew—curated to a fun theme.

How much does BarkBox cost?

Plans vary by subscription length and add-ons. Pricing is shown at checkout before you pay.

When will my BarkBox ship?

Your first box typically ships soon after you subscribe. Renewal boxes follow your billing schedule.

Can I customize for allergies or toy preferences?

Yes—many plans offer allergy-friendly treat options and toy size preferences. Availability can vary
by offer.

What if my dog destroys a toy?

We design for play, but every dog is different. Reach out to our Happy team if something misses the
mark.

Can I skip a month or cancel?

Most subscriptions can be managed online—skip a renewal or cancel before your next bill date.

Do you offer a happiness guarantee?

We want tails wagging. If something is not right, contact us and we will make it right when
eligible.

What is Super Chewer?

Super Chewer is our subscription for tough chewers, with durable rubber and nylon toys plus treats
and a chew.

Where does BarkBox ship?

We ship to the contiguous United States and other regions where offered. See checkout for your
address.

## Why BarkBox?

BarkBox is a monthly surprise that brings joy and enrichment to your pup’s life.

##### Obsession Guaranteed

Packed with wag-worthy toys and tasty treats, designed and hand-picked by experts.

##### Crazy Convenience

Delivering the perfect playtime directly to your door every month.

##### Personalized Play

Customized - from allergy-friendly snacks to toys designed for their size and play style.

## Frequently asked questions

What comes in a BarkBox?

Each monthly BarkBox includes two toys, two bags of treats, and a chew—curated to a fun theme.

How much does BarkBox cost?

Plans vary by subscription length and add-ons. Pricing is shown at checkout before you pay.

When will my BarkBox ship?

Your first box typically ships soon after you subscribe. Renewal boxes follow your billing schedule.

Can I customize for allergies or toy preferences?

Yes—many plans offer allergy-friendly treat options and toy size preferences. Availability can vary
by offer.

What if my dog destroys a toy?

We design for play, but every dog is different. Reach out to our Happy team if something misses the
mark.

Can I skip a month or cancel?

Most subscriptions can be managed online—skip a renewal or cancel before your next bill date.

Do you offer a happiness guarantee?

We want tails wagging. If something is not right, contact us and we will make it right when
eligible.

What is Super Chewer?

Super Chewer is our subscription for tough chewers, with durable rubber and nylon toys plus treats
and a chew.

Where does BarkBox ship?

We ship to the contiguous United States and other regions where offered. See checkout for your
address.

#### Welcome to
#### PAWTASTIC FRIENDS

🐾 About Pawtastic Friends:

Pawtastic Friends was built with the mission of providing life-changing enrichment training programs
to homeless dogs. Through the dedication of our professional trainers and amazing volunteers, we’re
giving dogs in need the skills, confidence, and guidance to help them successfully transition into
their furever homes. 🐶❤️

 

Your donation plays a crucial role in this journey! It helps provide basic training, aquatics, or
advanced training to a dog accepted into our program. With your support, you’re getting them one
step closer to their happily ever after! 🏡✨

[FOLLOW US]

## July

# Adoptee of the Month

## ROCKY

[image0.jpeg]

Meet Rocky 💙

Once surviving on the streets, Rocky is now building confidence at Pawtastic Friends and making
great strides with his wonderful foster. From learning to walk on a leash to playing with his foster
siblings, this sweet boy is finally discovering love, trust, and safety.

# [*Sponsor
# Rocky][20]

[Click here to meet him ][21]

## OUR MISSION

🐾 Welcome to Pawtastic Friends! 🐾

 

Here at Pawtastic Friends, we are committed to a single goal:

✨ Making the world a better place for homeless animals. ✨

 

As a private, non-profit organization, we dedicate ourselves daily to providing enrichment training
programs for homeless dogs. With your generosity and support, we can work together to achieve this
mission and give these deserving pups a brighter future. 🐶❤️

 

Through the Pawtastic Friends Enrichment Training Scholarship Programs, our goal is to prepare
homeless dogs for adoption, giving them the skills and confidence they need to thrive in their
furever homes. 🏡 In the meantime, we ensure they are surrounded with love by providing toys, food,
medical care, and supplies to keep them comfortable and happy until they find their families. 🦴🧸

 

Thank you for being a furbaby hero today! 🐾💖 Your support truly makes a difference in the lives of
these amazing animals.

#### Welcome to
#### PAWTASTIC FRIENDS

🐾 About Pawtastic Friends:

Pawtastic Friends was built with the mission of providing life-changing enrichment training programs
to homeless dogs. Through the dedication of our professional trainers and amazing volunteers, we’re
giving dogs in need the skills, confidence, and guidance to help them successfully transition into
their furever homes. 🐶❤️

 

Your donation plays a crucial role in this journey! It helps provide basic training, aquatics, or
advanced training to a dog accepted into our program. With your support, you’re getting them one
step closer to their happily ever after! 🏡✨

[FOLLOW US]

## July

# Adoptee of the Month

## ROCKY

[image0.jpeg]

Meet Rocky 💙

Once surviving on the streets, Rocky is now building confidence at Pawtastic Friends and making
great strides with his wonderful foster. From learning to walk on a leash to playing with his foster
siblings, this sweet boy is finally discovering love, trust, and safety.

# [*Sponsor
# Rocky][20]

[Click here to meet him ][21]

## OUR MISSION

🐾 Welcome to Pawtastic Friends! 🐾

 

Here at Pawtastic Friends, we are committed to a single goal:

✨ Making the world a better place for homeless animals. ✨

 

As a private, non-profit organization, we dedicate ourselves daily to providing enrichment training
programs for homeless dogs. With your generosity and support, we can work together to achieve this
mission and give these deserving pups a brighter future. 🐶❤️

 

Through the Pawtastic Friends Enrichment Training Scholarship Programs, our goal is to prepare
homeless dogs for adoption, giving them the skills and confidence they need to thrive in their
furever homes. 🏡 In the meantime, we ensure they are surrounded with love by providing toys, food,
medical care, and supplies to keep them comfortable and happy until they find their families. 🦴🧸

 

Thank you for being a furbaby hero today! 🐾💖 Your support truly makes a difference in the lives of
these amazing animals.

[Subject.png]

In today’s fast-paced world, convenience, quality, and personalized service define true luxury—not
only for people but for their pets as well.

Mobile pet grooming delivers all three, elevating the grooming experience into a high-end service
tailored to the needs of both pet and owner.

For pet parents and their furry companions who find a traditional salon setting challenging.

We provide the best experience for your dog in a crate free and comfortable environment.

All we need is a flat driveway and an outlet..


### How it Works

### Step 1

Schedule your mobile grooming service

Texting (508) 873-0553

### Step 2

Have your pet leashed and ready at the appointment time *

### Step 3

I will  arrive and give your pet a luxurious and expert grooming experience

### Step 4

Pay and book the next grooming session to keep your pet’s coat healthy and pristine

#### Our Mission is to Deliver High Quality Grooming With  Love and Care.

High quality shampoo with moisturizing mask included

Safe Drying and Brushing

### Hair cut to owners preferences or to breed profile. 

Hands-On one on one grooming with undivided attention, means safety and stress free enviroment

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How much does a typical grooming appointment cost?

Grooming costs vary based on breed, size, and coat condition. Dog grooming typically ranges
$75–$150, while cat grooming ranges $83–$138. We offer free quotes — call or book online.

How long does grooming take?

Most appointments take 2–4 hours depending on the service. Baths usually finish in 60–90 minutes.
We’ll give you a time estimate when you book.

What if my dog is anxious or has never been groomed before?

We specialize in anxious pets and first-timers. We go slow, use positive reinforcement, and can
break the appointment into multiple visits if needed. Let us know upfront so we can plan
accordingly.

Do you take my dog outside for a walk?

Yes. Daycare pets get multiple outdoor breaks and playtime throughout the day. We understand that
exercise and fresh air are part of the boarding experience.

What vaccinations are required?

We require current vaccinations (rabies, DHPP for dogs, and FVRCP for cats) and a negative recent
health check. Proof required at first visit.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How much does a typical grooming appointment cost?

Grooming costs vary based on breed, size, and coat condition. Dog grooming typically ranges
$75–$150, while cat grooming ranges $83–$138. We offer free quotes — call or book online.

How long does grooming take?

Most appointments take 2–4 hours depending on the service. Baths usually finish in 60–90 minutes.
We’ll give you a time estimate when you book.

What if my dog is anxious or has never been groomed before?

We specialize in anxious pets and first-timers. We go slow, use positive reinforcement, and can
break the appointment into multiple visits if needed. Let us know upfront so we can plan
accordingly.

Do you take my dog outside for a walk?

Yes. Daycare pets get multiple outdoor breaks and playtime throughout the day. We understand that
exercise and fresh air are part of the boarding experience.

What vaccinations are required?

We require current vaccinations (rabies, DHPP for dogs, and FVRCP for cats) and a negative recent
health check. Proof required at first visit.

## MOBILE GROOMING FAQ's

Commonly asked questions about Mobile Pet Grooming by Doog

### What is mobile pet grooming?

Mobile pet grooming is a convenient service that brings professional grooming directly to your
doorstep. Our skilled groomers arrive in a fully equipped van to provide a range of grooming
services for your pets in a stress-free and familiar environment.

### What services do you offer?

We offer a comprehensive range of grooming services, including baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear
cleaning, and more. Our goal is to enhance your pet's well-being while keeping them looking and
feeling their best.

### How do I book an appointment?

Booking an appointment is easy! You can reach out to us through our website, phone, or email. Simply
provide your contact details, preferred date, and services needed, and we'll find a convenient time
to groom your pet.

### Are your groomers trained and experienced?

Yes, our groomers are experienced professionals who have a deep passion for animals. They undergo
training to ensure they provide safe and comfortable grooming sessions for your pets.

### How long does a grooming session take?

The duration of a grooming session depends on your pet's size, coat condition, and the services
requested. On average, a grooming session can take anywhere from 1 to 3 hours.

### What products do you use?

We use high-quality, organic, and pet-friendly products that prioritize your pet's health and
well-being. Our products are carefully selected to ensure they're safe and effective for various
coat types and skin sensitivities.

### How often should I groom my pet?

The frequency of grooming depends on your pet's breed, coat type, and individual needs. Generally,
dogs should be groomed every 4 to 8 weeks, while cats may need grooming less often. Our groomers can
recommend a grooming schedule based on your pet's requirements.

## MOBILE GROOMING FAQ's

Commonly asked questions about Mobile Pet Grooming by Doog

### What is mobile pet grooming?

Mobile pet grooming is a convenient service that brings professional grooming directly to your
doorstep. Our skilled groomers arrive in a fully equipped van to provide a range of grooming
services for your pets in a stress-free and familiar environment.

### What services do you offer?

We offer a comprehensive range of grooming services, including baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear
cleaning, and more. Our goal is to enhance your pet's well-being while keeping them looking and
feeling their best.

### How do I book an appointment?

Booking an appointment is easy! You can reach out to us through our website, phone, or email. Simply
provide your contact details, preferred date, and services needed, and we'll find a convenient time
to groom your pet.

### Are your groomers trained and experienced?

Yes, our groomers are experienced professionals who have a deep passion for animals. They undergo
training to ensure they provide safe and comfortable grooming sessions for your pets.

### How long does a grooming session take?

The duration of a grooming session depends on your pet's size, coat condition, and the services
requested. On average, a grooming session can take anywhere from 1 to 3 hours.

### What products do you use?

We use high-quality, organic, and pet-friendly products that prioritize your pet's health and
well-being. Our products are carefully selected to ensure they're safe and effective for various
coat types and skin sensitivities.

### How often should I groom my pet?

The frequency of grooming depends on your pet's breed, coat type, and individual needs. Generally,
dogs should be groomed every 4 to 8 weeks, while cats may need grooming less often. Our groomers can
recommend a grooming schedule based on your pet's requirements.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### +What is the budget needed to launch a new product?

It depends on your stage and your launch goals:

**Established brands: **If you’re already selling consistently, [reach out][49] to discuss a
tailored launch plan and budget aligned with your growth goals.

**[Private Label][50]: **While the absolute minimum budget is around $2,000, most launches require
$5,000 to $10,000 at minimum. A more competitive small private label launch typically falls in the
$10,000 to $30,000 range, not including marketing and fulfillment costs.

**New brands launches with custom formulation: **If your brand launch strategy requires a [fully
custom product][51] from the start, expect around $10,000 for R&D and sampling. Production typically
requires an additional $10,000 to $20,000. A more competitive small custom launch typically falls in
the $30,000 to $50,000 range, not including marketing and fulfillment costs.

### +What is the expected lead time?

Our typical manufacturing lead time varies from 4 to 6 weeks for Private Label offerings and 6 to 12
weeks for custom manufacturing, depending on product category, time of year and packaging and
ingredient selection.

For recurring production (1,000+ units per week), we optimize operations to maintain 4 to 8 weeks of
rolling inventory after onboarding.

### +Where are FormuNova products made?

All our products are manufactured right here in the United States. Our FDA-registered, GMP-certified
facility is located just outside of Atlanta, GA. We adhere to stringent quality standards, certified
by NSF, while ensuring fast lead times, transparent processes, and a product you can trust.

### +What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ)?

**MOQ 3,000 units – Full Custom Development**

For established brands ready to own a one-of-a-kind product. We can transfer or improve your
existing formula, reverse engineer a benchmark, or develop a completely new custom formulation based
on your goals. Minimums may be higher depending on ingredient and packaging goals. [Learn more][52].

**MOQ 500 units – Customize Our Base Formulas**

For early-stage brands with some traction in the market, you can start with one of our proven bases
and make it yours with custom packaging.

**MOQ 140 units – Private Label Launch**

The fastest path to market for brands of all sizes and pre-launch brands. Launch in weeks with
ready-to-go formulations branded with your logo and labels. [Learn more][53].

**Tech Transfer / Recurring Production Schedule**
Enterprise-grade manufacturing access, without enterprise-level volume barriers. Structured tech
transfer with recurring production starting at ~1,000 units per week. [Learn more][54].

### +What sets FormuNova apart from other manufacturers?

Most manufacturers focus on scaling their own private label formulas. We focus on scaling your
brand.
* **Built to launch and scale differentiated brands:** With in-house R&D, a dedicated Sample Lab,
  and a highly flexible production setup, we move brands from idea to market fast. Whether starting
  from our evergreen private label catalog or scaling into full custom, we provide the
  infrastructure, speed, and supply chain reliability needed to build a unique, competitive product
  line.
* **Growth partnership: **Our team understands what it takes to succeed in ecommerce and retail,
  supporting you beyond production as you scale.
* **Total compliance handled:** FDA-registered, GMP-certified U.S.-based facility with full
  retail-ready compliance support.
* **Full-stack partner:** Packaging, labeling, and logistics handled end-to-end so you can stay
  focused on sales and growth.

FormuNova is a manufacturing partner for brands ready to scale.

### +What services does FormuNova offer?

We help brands move from idea to scale. That means:
* **Ready-to-launch products** with Private Label formulas branded for you.
* **Customized formulations** by adapting proven bases to your vision.
* **Full product development** for unique formulas built from scratch by our in-house R&D and Sample
  Lab team.

Alongside formulation and manufacturing, we can handle packaging sourcing, compliance, fulfillment
(3PL), design and inventory management services, so you and your team can focus 100% on growing your
brand.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### +What is the budget needed to launch a new product?

It depends on your stage and your launch goals:

**Established brands: **If you’re already selling consistently, [reach out][49] to discuss a
tailored launch plan and budget aligned with your growth goals.

**[Private Label][50]: **While the absolute minimum budget is around $2,000, most launches require
$5,000 to $10,000 at minimum. A more competitive small private label launch typically falls in the
$10,000 to $30,000 range, not including marketing and fulfillment costs.

**New brands launches with custom formulation: **If your brand launch strategy requires a [fully
custom product][51] from the start, expect around $10,000 for R&D and sampling. Production typically
requires an additional $10,000 to $20,000. A more competitive small custom launch typically falls in
the $30,000 to $50,000 range, not including marketing and fulfillment costs.

### +What is the expected lead time?

Our typical manufacturing lead time varies from 4 to 6 weeks for Private Label offerings and 6 to 12
weeks for custom manufacturing, depending on product category, time of year and packaging and
ingredient selection.

For recurring production (1,000+ units per week), we optimize operations to maintain 4 to 8 weeks of
rolling inventory after onboarding.

### +Where are FormuNova products made?

All our products are manufactured right here in the United States. Our FDA-registered, GMP-certified
facility is located just outside of Atlanta, GA. We adhere to stringent quality standards, certified
by NSF, while ensuring fast lead times, transparent processes, and a product you can trust.

### +What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ)?

**MOQ 3,000 units – Full Custom Development**

For established brands ready to own a one-of-a-kind product. We can transfer or improve your
existing formula, reverse engineer a benchmark, or develop a completely new custom formulation based
on your goals. Minimums may be higher depending on ingredient and packaging goals. [Learn more][52].

**MOQ 500 units – Customize Our Base Formulas**

For early-stage brands with some traction in the market, you can start with one of our proven bases
and make it yours with custom packaging.

**MOQ 140 units – Private Label Launch**

The fastest path to market for brands of all sizes and pre-launch brands. Launch in weeks with
ready-to-go formulations branded with your logo and labels. [Learn more][53].

**Tech Transfer / Recurring Production Schedule**
Enterprise-grade manufacturing access, without enterprise-level volume barriers. Structured tech
transfer with recurring production starting at ~1,000 units per week. [Learn more][54].

### +What sets FormuNova apart from other manufacturers?

Most manufacturers focus on scaling their own private label formulas. We focus on scaling your
brand.
* **Built to launch and scale differentiated brands:** With in-house R&D, a dedicated Sample Lab,
  and a highly flexible production setup, we move brands from idea to market fast. Whether starting
  from our evergreen private label catalog or scaling into full custom, we provide the
  infrastructure, speed, and supply chain reliability needed to build a unique, competitive product
  line.
* **Growth partnership: **Our team understands what it takes to succeed in ecommerce and retail,
  supporting you beyond production as you scale.
* **Total compliance handled:** FDA-registered, GMP-certified U.S.-based facility with full
  retail-ready compliance support.
* **Full-stack partner:** Packaging, labeling, and logistics handled end-to-end so you can stay
  focused on sales and growth.

FormuNova is a manufacturing partner for brands ready to scale.

### +What services does FormuNova offer?

We help brands move from idea to scale. That means:
* **Ready-to-launch products** with Private Label formulas branded for you.
* **Customized formulations** by adapting proven bases to your vision.
* **Full product development** for unique formulas built from scratch by our in-house R&D and Sample
  Lab team.

Alongside formulation and manufacturing, we can handle packaging sourcing, compliance, fulfillment
(3PL), design and inventory management services, so you and your team can focus 100% on growing your
brand.

Whether you’re launching fast with Private Label or scaling big with Custom Manufacturing, we can
handle the science, compliance, and production so you can focus on growth.

# Mobile Pet Grooming Made Easy with Groomeer

Premium mobile grooming that comes to you. Schedule, relax, and
pamper your pet — all from your front door.

[ Book an Appointment ][15]
[Professional mobile pet grooming service providing home grooming care for dog in San Francisco]
[Woman in a polka dot sweater kisses a Boston Terrier she's holding in her arms, showing the bond
that comes from dedicated pet care, against a plain background.]

## I’m a Pet Owner

### Ready to treat my furry friend to a stress-free grooming at home.

Skip the hassle of crowded salons—get expert grooming brought right to your doorstep. Book a
professional groomer through Groomeer and give your pet the care they deserve.

[ For Clients ][16]
[Smiling groomer in an apron gives a thumbs up, wearing a mustard yellow shirt and looking
confident.]

#### I’m a Groomer

##### Looking to grow my business and connect with more pet families.

Join Groomeer’s mobile platform to manage bookings, grow your client base, showcase your skills, and
focus on delivering exceptional grooming experiences—all while building a business you truly love.

[ For Partners ][17]

### Mobile Grooming That Puts Pets First

The Groomeer team believes that pet grooming should be both convenient and stress-free, filled with
love for pets and their owners. Our full-service mobile pet grooming company sends certified pet
stylists to your home to provide convenient pet grooming services that eliminate traditional salon
stress.

Our skilled dog and cat grooming staff provide safe and comfortable pet grooming services through
the use of premium products and gentle grooming methods. Our team offers customized pet care
services that include standard baths, as well as specialized cuts tailored to different breeds.

Groomeer exists as a community beyond its service offerings. Our user-friendly platform and app
enable loving pet owners to find passionate groomers. The Groomeer platform exists to simplify pet
care services for both parents with busy schedules and working professionals.

[ Read More ][18]

#### Book, Manage, Relax

### Seamless Scheduling With Technology That Works for You

Groomeer’s cloud-based client management system lets you book, pay, and track appointments from any
device:
* Available on iOS, Android, and Web
* Schedule and reschedule appointments anytime
* Get appointment reminders and status updates
* View grooming history for each pet
* Secure online payments
* Real-time availability with local groomers

Your time is valuable, and your pet’s care shouldn’t be complicated. Groomeer makes grooming simple
and transparent—just a few clicks and you’re done!

[ [Black rectangular button with the Apple logo and "Download on the App Store" in white—perfect for
dog owners seeking mobile pet grooming or easy cat grooming services.] ][19]

and gray letters—perfect for apps related to mobile pet grooming, cat grooming, or dog grooming.]
][20]
[Professional mobile pet grooming service van arriving at San Francisco home for convenient pet
care]

### Fur-tastic mobile pet grooming services with Groomeer

**The biggest challenge for independent groomers isn’t skill—it’s client acquisition.** Traditional
marketing is expensive, time-consuming, and often ineffective. Groomeer solves this problem by
giving you instant visibility to thousands of pet owners in your community who are actively looking
to book mobile grooming services.

#### What Pet Owners Are Saying

"Groomeer made life so much easier for us! No more stressful car rides for my anxious pup. The
groomer came right to our driveway, and my dog looked absolutely adorable!"
Jessica M.
"As a groomer, joining Groomeer was the best decision I made. I can set my schedule, pick my
clients, and focus on what I love—grooming pets. The app is super easy to use!"
Carlos D.
"I couldn’t believe how simple it was to book! The groomer was professional, gentle with my senior

Amira K.

IPG CERTIFICATIONS

 

TRACK 1: Safety Certification

Certified Professional Groomer (CPG) Safety certification for Groomers, who will do a bath and dry
and clippered pet trim on any breed. Also available in Spanish.

 

Certified Cat Groomer (CCG) Safety certification for Cat Groomers, who will do a bath and dry on a
cat.

 

Certified Pet Professional (CPP) safety certification for Bathers, Salon or Day Care Staff. Also
available in Spanish.

 

TRACK 2:Advanced Certification 

Advanced Professional Groomer (APG)  Advancing groomers use advanced grooming skills to demonstrate
shape, style and symmetry and groom a toy breed and a double coated breed.

 

Advanced Cat Groomer (ACG) More cat behavior and working with special needs cats, and includes one
groom.

 

TRACK 3: Master Groomers

International Certified Master Groomer (ICMG)  Advanced Breed Profile grooming with 5 modules:
Masters written test (to become MC--Masters Candidate), then Non-Sporting, Sporting, Terriers and
Mixed Breeds.

 

Certified Master Cat Groomer (CMCG) covers cat breeds and their special needs and demonstrating
advanced cat grooming skills.


SPECIAL PRICING for Schools, large salons and multiple site companies.  Educating and certifying
groomers throughout the world is so important, we would love to work with YOU! Contact Linda at
[ipgicmg@gmail.com][26] for more information

# Custom Van Builders in Florida

#### Florida's premier custom van builders specializing in adventure and commercial van conversions
#### for Mercedes Sprinter, Ford Transit, and RAM Promaster vehicles.

[ Get Started ][29]

## Meet Mat & the Mango Vans Crew.

## **Expert Camper Van Builders Crafting Your Adventure**

Our company is a team of builders, travellers, and dreamers that enjoy creating awesome tiny homes
on wheels.
From adventure-ready camper vans to fully equipped commercial van conversions, our van builders
bring your vision to life with quality craftsmanship and sustainable materials

[ CHECK OUT OUR BUILD PROCESS ][30]

### **Mango Vans Advantage**

[Sustainability]

### Sustainability

### Sustainability

We consider our impact on the environment. We use with green building-materials like natural wool
insulation and sustainably sourced bamboo. We use high quality [products][31] that are more
efficient to run as much on solar as possible.

[Options]

### Options

### Options

We offer many customization options in our builds to give you the features that match your budget.

[Time]

### Time

### Time

Our standardized layout options help get your van designed and built efficiently, so you can spend
less time planning and get on the road faster.

[Value]

### Value

### Value

We have a wide range of options for many budgets. Our average [conversion package][32] is about 45K,
very basic builds can cost half that, and we have enough options available to more than double it.

[Simplicity]

### Simplicity

### Simplicity

We design our builds with clean lines, bright colors, and lots of open space. Sturdy, lightweight
construction, plumbing and electrical systems that are practical and easily serviced. We build stuff
that looks great and just works.

### **Our Van Conversion Company Philosophy: Quality & Sustainability**

#### As a leading van conversion company in Florida, the Mango Vans philosophy is to focus on
#### simplicity, efficiency, and sustainability. From the products we use to the systems we design,
#### we build things that look great and just work. From years of building many different
#### configurations in all sorts of vehicles, we have flexible designs at a competitive price that
#### can be customized with additional features to match your budget.

[ CHECK OUT OUR BUILD PROCESS ➜ ][33]

deck by Aluminess with their side ladder and surf poles for bringing SUPs on the road to adventure.

# Helping Small Businesses Is Our Job

If you are an aspiring entrepreneur or an existing business owner in Maryland… the Maryland Small
Business Development Center (SBDC) offers FREE individualized consulting, from start up to
established businesses. Maryland SBDC also offers comprehensive training programs, from those just
thinking about starting a business to executive training, with most classes at low to no cost. The
Maryland SBDC Network provides Maryland small business owners with access to trusted business
advisors who have experience in starting and growing businesses. We offer expertise and keen
insights essential to helping you manage your concerns today, and design solid, long-range plans to
secure your vision for tomorrow. Please note: We have always been only able to assist those legally
present in the United States.

[Request Assistance][20]

## What We Do

Since 1988 the seasoned staff of the Maryland Small Business Development Center (SBDC) Network has
provided sound advice consulting and support to entrepreneurs and small businesses across the state.
We are part of a national SBDC network—founded in 1979—that helps over 500,000 U.S. businesses
annually.

### Business Consulting

Get no- or low-cost consulting in the areas of MONEY MANAGEMENT and MARKETING.

[Learn About Business Consulting][21]

### Business Training

Get no- or low-cost training in the areas of MONEY MANAGEMENT and MARKETING.

[Learn About Business Training][22]

### Business Funding

We help you get funding for your business from a variety of sources.

[Learn About Business Funding][23]

## Success Stories

Entrepreneurs have great ideas that they want to see manifested in a successful business. Most of
the time they are missing some critical information guidance or skill that would make all the
difference. Here are examples of Maryland SBDC clients who were able to succeed with our guidance.

## Procurement doesn't capture the value already sitting in it's existing portfolio...

01 — The reality
Data scattered across multiple systems

Spreadsheets on shared drives. Records in SAP, Oracle, Coupa. Contacts in Outlook. The same supplier
exists three times under three names.

02 — The consequence
No transparency on what you have

You can’t search what you can’t see. Capabilities and risk signals exist in fragments — never as one
queryable picture of your portfolio.

03 — The blind spot
Hidden potential in portfolio and markets

You source new suppliers for capabilities you already have. Existing partners are passed over
because nobody knows what they can do.

Missed opportunities and market changes

Every new initiative starts from a partial view. Decisions miss the alternatives you never knew
existed.

# Mobile Pet Grooming

**Serving South-Central Austin**
[CONTACT][3]
For an estimate text us at
[+1 (512)269 2511][4]
[info@mobilepetgroomingaustin.com][5]
OPEN MONDAY TO FRIDAY 8-4 pm

## Our team

Park and Bark LLC was founded in Austin, Texas by husband-and-wife team Ramon and Selene, who turned
their shared passion for animals into a family-run mobile grooming service. They first met 16 years
ago while working in the animal care industry, and today they share a busy, pet-filled life with
their two energetic teenagers, three cats, and a 10-year-old white Siberian Husky. Beyond grooming,
Ramon and Selene are also dedicated volunteers, lending their time and care to help local trappers
and animal rescue efforts. Their deep love for animals shows in every aspect of their work. As
Accredited Professional Pet Groomers and CPR-certified professionals, they combine experience with
compassion. Their approach is gentle, patient, and attentive—helping pets feel comfortable and safe
by tuning in to their body language and emotional needs. They focus on creating a calm, cage-free,
one-on-one experience that prioritizes your pet’s well-being, grooming quality, and overall
happiness. Always staying current with the latest grooming trends, tools, and techniques, Ramon and
Selene are committed to treating your pets like their own—because to them, pets are family.

**FAMILY OWNED**

## Your pet comes first!

**With over a decade of experience in the pet care industry, Park & Bark LLC is proud to be one of
Austin's highest-rated mobile pet grooming companies, trusted by hundreds of local pet owners for
our gentle, compassionate, one-on-one care. Every pet is treated like family!**
* ### 1. Service
  
  One-on-one pampering, premium products, and unparalleled service.
* ### 2. Luxury
  
  Luxury grooming for dogs and cats, delivered with love and care.
* ### 3. Happy
  
  We bring the spa to you, so your pet stays happy, healthy, and stylish.

## Services

### Choose local and small!

We're a **family owned** business that specializes in small to medium size dogs but will groom
breeds up to **75 pounds**. Our estimates are subject to change due to your dog's coat condition,
dry time and behavior. **Services Park and Bark LLC provides:**
* 1
  Bath Only
  **75 lb weight limit**
  * Nails Trimmed & filed. Shave pads (if necessary)
  * Brushing out knots and debris and undercoat removal.
  * Double Shampoo, conditioner, massage and hydro bath.
  * Blueberry facial.
  * Ears and eyes gently cleaned – ear hair plucked upon request.
  * Anal glands expressed (only by request).
  * Towel dry face and hand blow dry body.
  * Final brush and bluff.
  * Bandana or Bow.
* 2
  Mini Groom
  **45 lb weight limit**
  * Nails Trimmed & filed.
  * Brushing out knots and debris and undercoat removal.
  * Sanitary clip.
  * Double Shampoo, conditioner, massage and hydro bath.
  * Blueberry facial.
  * Ears and eyes gently cleaned – ear hair plucked upon request.
  * Anal glands expressed (only by request).
  * Towel dry face and hand blow dry body.
  * Shave pads and scissor paws.
  * Scissor up eyes and t-area.
  * Final brush and bluff.
  * Bandana or Bow.
* 3
  Full Groom
  **45 lb weight limit**
  * Nails Trimmed & Filed.
  * Brushing out knots, sanitary clip and undercoat removal.
  * Double Shampoo, conditioner, massage and hydro bath.
  * Blueberry facial.
  * Ears and eyes gently cleaned – ear hair plucked upon request.
  * Anal glands expressed (only by request).
  * Towel dry face and hand blow dry body.
  * Shave pads and scissor paws.
  * Bangs Clipped.
  * Face Scissored.
  * Trim up silhouette (if necessary).
  * Breed cut or full body haircut.
  * Final brush and bluff.
  * Bandana or Bow.
Add
-ons
* Deshedding starting at $15
* Hard to handle fee starting at $20
* Face trim starting at $35
* Teeth Brushing $15
* Nose and paw moisturizing $10
* Flea and tick treatment $20
* Mobile nails only? $55 starting cost. $40 for each additional pet.
* Also offering gentle grooming training for dogs with little to no experience.
Park & Bark LLC comes to you and also offers a complete range of cat grooming services. Cats require
knowledgeable handling to ensure their safety.

### Why Outlet Mobile Pet Grooming ?

Outlet Mobile Pet Grooming is convenient for your pet’s overall grooming needs with personalized
service and highly qualified stylists. We’ll handle them with the love and attention they deserve
from arrival to departure. In addition, *we offer full-service bathing and grooming* and special
upgrades to pamper your dog. You can also choose from our extra options, and be sure to ask about
specials when you book your appointment.

### Cleanliness

We can guarantee a 100% sanitary environment for your pet. Our environments are cleaned in-between
each service with organic, pet friendly cleaners. Just as important your pet is not at risk for
disease they can contract at a traditional grooming service such as: kennel cough, parasites,
rabies, distemper/parvo, and Bordetella.

Your pet is in good hands with our team of professional staff of groomers and trainers. We offer
your pet only the top quality service.

mobility needs. Our ability to provide one-on-one attention to your pet means zero accidents and
injuries. Safety is our first priority.

bud. With Outlet Mobile Pet Grooming, a skilled professional can come to your home to arrange a
grooming session for your pet. You can forget about wrestling your pooch or kitty into your sedan or
worrying about how they will behave in an unfamiliar place. Your pet will receive the care they are
used to but in the comfort of their environment.

for one-on-one attention during the session. We take the time to understand their personality and

schedule.

##### Anal gland expression

For some dogs, especially smaller breeds, the anal glands can become an issue if not expressed
regularly. If you think your furry buddy has difficulty here, our groomer can get the job done to
release any fluid buildup and ward off infection risks.

##### Deshedding and dematting

For breeds that shed heavily, our mobile pet groomer can perform a treatment to remove loose hair
and minimize shedding for several weeks. We can also take care of mats and tangles to prevent
painful pulling on your dog’s skin.

##### Anti-skunk

An anti-skunk treatment is best for pets that need some freshening up. We will thoroughly deodorize
your pooch using special products and remove all traces of that unpleasant smell.

# PETME Pet Care Services

At PETME we offer a variety of professional pet care services in Dubai. From grooming to dog
training, we have it all! Whether you simply wish for a place to drop off your PET for a few hours
or require longer pet boarding services in Dubai, we have you covered! We offer special rates and
packages for extended stays so you can rest assured your pet is being taken care of in a safe and
nurturing environment. We also offer weekend pet care for those weekend staycations! Does your furry
friend need grooming or a bath? We would love to pamper them! Short of time? Let us take some of the
stress out of your day by combining a grooming session with our day care with home pick up and drop
off. Give us a call today to find out what we can offer you and your beloved pet!

We go beyond just serving your pets, our premises come with a cozy café in Dubai where you can
unwind with a cup of coffee or a bite to eat. Whether you’ve walked in to buy pet supplies or to
have your furry cared for, you can play with our very own pets aka PETME members and you can be sure
to find these trained, good natured and playful furry members entertaining. On the other hand,
having a hot or refreshing beverage at PETCAFE is also a cool idea as you sit across from the play
area and watch our pet guests in action as they mingle, snuggle, tussle and bark at just anything.

[Petme Cafe]

## PETCAFE

[Petme Zoo]

## DOG SOCIAL CLUB

Our team loves to entertain and be entertained, both the staff and our very own PETME canine members
love companionship. If you look around our playground, you will be sure to spot our very own pets
wearing black and yellow collars. PETME members are there as canine companions for play and sleep.
They are well trained and socialized so our pet parents can be confident that their dogs are in good
company.


We also offer “meet our PETME members” sessions in Dubai where you can meet and play with our dogs.
Whether you have a pet or not, and you or your kids would love to spend some fun time with a furry,
we are here to offer you that. After all, our members love playing and being petted.

# Partnering with P&G for Excellence.

The P&G Supplier Portal brings together all the tools, resources, and support you need to work
efficiently with P&G. Manage invoices, purchase orders, and key supplier processes — all in one
place.

## P&G Q3 FY 25/26 Earnings Release

Sharing an update on P&G’s Q3 2026 earnings, Erik Roberts highlights strong results, trusted
partnerships, Middle East supply chain challenges, and shared progress on sustainability and
innovation.

[Learn More][58]

## Tools & Services

Access essential tools used by P&G suppliers for invoicing, procurement, supply chain operations,
compliance, and training.

## Become a P&G Supplier

Becoming a P&G supplier means joining a global network built on trust, quality, and long-term
partnership. Here you'll find everything you need to understand our processes, requirements, and
expectations. We'll guide you through setting up your profile, submitting your information, and
starting your collaboration. Begin your journey with P&G and discover what it takes to become a
trusted supplier.

Ritzy Pet Spa, provides high-quality and affordable mobile pet grooming and non-anesthetic dental
cleaning services in Weston, Plantation, Fort Lauderdale, and all cities across Broward County. Our
Highly Skilled Pet Care Specialists will take great care of your pet in our top-of-the-line grooming
vehicle.

We have all the pro tools you expect to find in a modern salon: full bathtub with clean hot and cold

Copy Page

This page will help you get started with rollMyFile JavaScript API to open hundreds of different
file types on the Web.

# Using rollMyFile API in JavaScript

On a page, where you want to let users open files, you simply do the following

HTML

`<script type="text/javascript" src="https://api.rollapp.com/2/js/rollmyfile.js"></script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    var key = "SeCur3AP1K3y";

    var rollMyFile = new RollMyFile(key);
</script>
`

And then all it takes to open a file is

JavaScript

`rollMyFile.openFileByUrl("https://www.example.com/documentation/overview.docx");
`

# Pet Sitting, Dog Walking, Mobile Pet Grooming &   
# So Much More

## Taking Personalized Home Pet Care to the Next Level

Pets are beloved members of your family, and just like any other family member, they have their own
unique needs and personalities. That’s why conventional pet care programs just won’t cut it! At
Woofie's®, we have a bone to pick with cookie-cutter pet care companies. We are a pet care company
that is about so much more than just walks and washes. 

### Your Trusted Pet Experts

Our local Woofie's teams are passionate providers of personalized pet services, including pet
sitting, dog walking, mobile grooming, and more. They take the time to get to know you and your pet
so that they can provide them with the best care. Whether you are looking for in-home pet care for
your dog, cat, fish, iguana, or ferret – or another beloved pet – Woofie's is the one to trust for
compassionate and attentive services. 

**Give Woofie's a call at **[**(844) 474-9663**][35] **for personalized home pet care!**

## Our Services

Whether you’re going on vacation and need a trustworthy pet sitter or want to pamper your pet with
full-service mobile grooming, your local Woofie's team is ready to help. Their experienced pet
professionals will give you the peace of mind of knowing that your pet is in the best possible
hands.
* [Pet Sitting]
  
  ### Pet Sitting
  
  Going on vacation and need someone to care for your pet in your absence? With Woofie's pet sitting
  services, you can rest assured your pet will be safe and happy so that you can enjoy your time
  away.
  
  [Explore Care Options][36]
* [Dog Walking]
  
  ### Dog Walking
  
  Worrying about your dog while you’re at work or away for the day is stressful. Woofie's is here to
  help with mid-day walks, visits, and more!
  
  [Pick Your Schedule][37]
* [Mobile Pet Spa]
  
  ### Mobile Pet Spa
  
  Designed with your convenience and your pet’s comfort in mind, Woofie's mobile pet spa brings the
  premium grooming salon experience right to your front door.
  
  [Pamper Your Pet][38]

[View All Services][39]

## Designed with Convenience in Mind

Woofie's is committed to making pet care services more convenient for pet parents and providing
individualized care to their pets. Each Woofie's team brings our services to you and tailors your
pet care program to meet your pet’s unique needs. Does your pet prefer brisk walks to exert their
energy or slow, sniff-filled strolls? Woofie's is ready to accommodate these and other preferences.
Never worry about rushing out to doggy daycare or dragging your pet to the groomer on the weekend –
with Woofie's, you can sit back and relax while the professionals take care of it all.

Woofie's prioritizes the health, safety, and happiness of your pets, and every Woofie's team member
is trained and experienced in professional home pet care. High-quality, trustworthy home pet care
has never been easier or more convenient.

Woofie’s always puts safety first, and we take the time to earn your pet’s trust (and yours too!),
so we can give them the best possible care.

# Pet Sitting, Dog Walking, Mobile Pet Grooming &   
# So Much More

## Taking Personalized Home Pet Care to the Next Level

Pets are beloved members of your family, and just like any other family member, they have their own
unique needs and personalities. That’s why conventional pet care programs just won’t cut it! At
Woofie's®, we have a bone to pick with cookie-cutter pet care companies. We are a pet care company
that is about so much more than just walks and washes. 

### Your Trusted Pet Experts

Our local Woofie's teams are passionate providers of personalized pet services, including pet
sitting, dog walking, mobile grooming, and more. They take the time to get to know you and your pet
so that they can provide them with the best care. Whether you are looking for in-home pet care for
your dog, cat, fish, iguana, or ferret – or another beloved pet – Woofie's is the one to trust for
compassionate and attentive services. 

**Give Woofie's a call at **[**(844) 474-9663**][35] **for personalized home pet care!**

## Our Services

Whether you’re going on vacation and need a trustworthy pet sitter or want to pamper your pet with
full-service mobile grooming, your local Woofie's team is ready to help. Their experienced pet
professionals will give you the peace of mind of knowing that your pet is in the best possible
hands.
* [Pet Sitting]
  
  ### Pet Sitting
  
  Going on vacation and need someone to care for your pet in your absence? With Woofie's pet sitting
  services, you can rest assured your pet will be safe and happy so that you can enjoy your time
  away.
  
  [Explore Care Options][36]
* [Dog Walking]
  
  ### Dog Walking
  
  Worrying about your dog while you’re at work or away for the day is stressful. Woofie's is here to
  help with mid-day walks, visits, and more!
  
  [Pick Your Schedule][37]
* [Mobile Pet Spa]
  
  ### Mobile Pet Spa
  
  Designed with your convenience and your pet’s comfort in mind, Woofie's mobile pet spa brings the
  premium grooming salon experience right to your front door.
  
  [Pamper Your Pet][38]

[View All Services][39]

## Designed with Convenience in Mind

Woofie's is committed to making pet care services more convenient for pet parents and providing
individualized care to their pets. Each Woofie's team brings our services to you and tailors your
pet care program to meet your pet’s unique needs. Does your pet prefer brisk walks to exert their
energy or slow, sniff-filled strolls? Woofie's is ready to accommodate these and other preferences.
Never worry about rushing out to doggy daycare or dragging your pet to the groomer on the weekend –
with Woofie's, you can sit back and relax while the professionals take care of it all.

Woofie's prioritizes the health, safety, and happiness of your pets, and every Woofie's team member
is trained and experienced in professional home pet care. High-quality, trustworthy home pet care
has never been easier or more convenient.

Woofie’s always puts safety first, and we take the time to earn your pet’s trust (and yours too!),
so we can give them the best possible care. 
* > **- Stacey**
* > “I have found a gem in Woofie’s! Jenn was my groomer and she performed a miracle for my aging
  > anxiety filled pup. We always have issues with bathing and nail trimming for him...”
  > 
  > **- Kristen**
* > “They go the extra mile to make you and your pet feel comfortable… They are like family to us.”
  > 
  > **- Ramona**
* > “Their service and professionalism is top notch. We are glad that we found them.”
  > 
  > **- Jim**
